dedupeText: new wave torn paper collage 80s aesthetic torn paper effect monochromatic blue high contrast portrait new wave layered composition diagonal division via a jagged torn paper texture contrast between natural skin tones and deep monochromatic blue repetition of the subject s gaze across the split juxtaposition of soft hair textures against hard industrial backgrounds combine a high contrast color portrait with its monochromatic blue twin using a jagged diagonal paper tear mask then anchor the composition with high contrast serif typography in the corners

recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-tone portrait composition featuring a torn-paper aesthetic that splits the frame diagonally. One side shows a high-contrast, full-color fashion portrait with industrial textures, while the other side presents a monochromatic blue-tinted mirror image or variation, separated by a jagged white paper edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal division via a jagged, torn-paper texture
Contrast between natural skin tones and deep monochromatic blue
Repetition of the subject's gaze across the split
Juxtaposition of soft hair textures against hard industrial backgrounds
coreInvariants: Diagonal composition flow from top-left to bottom-right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a medium close-up portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, with a secondary, slightly smaller version on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes in the full-color section serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal tear from the top-right down to the bottom-center, bouncing between the two versions of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the clothing and background provide dark negative space that makes the blonde hair and white text pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays in the clothing and industrial background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Monochromatic cyan/blue tinting on the right-hand side of the tear.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright blonde hair and white paper edges.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright highlights of the hair and the deep shadows of the outfit; saturation is localized to the left side.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast serif and elegant italic serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a bold, wide-set serif with sharp triangular serifs
Bottom text uses a slender, high-contrast transitional italic
Graphic bars or stripes integrated into the top letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal stripes or color blocks cutting through the center of the top display text

anatomy.strokeCharacter: Uniform thicks with very thin thins

treatment.fill: Solid white with internal color bars

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the dark negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, geometric display serif and a delicate, traditional italic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, sharp serif look of the top text.
Captures the elegant, traditional feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast 1980s fashion portrait of a woman with voluminous blonde hair in a dark industrial setting. Apply a diagonal torn-paper effect from top-right to bottom-left. The area to the right of the tear should be a monochromatic blue-tinted version of the same scene.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, wide serif display title in the top right, featuring a horizontal stripe graphic through the letters. Add a stacked, elegant italic subtitle in the bottom left corner in white.

verificationChecks: Is the tear line jagged and white like real paper?
Is the right side strictly monochromatic blue?
Does the top text have high-contrast serifs?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep shadows?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the graphic stripes in the text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

avoid: Vector-perfect straight lines for the tear

postGenerationChecks: Check that the tear doesn't look like a simple mask but has paper fiber texture.
Ensure the blue tint doesn't bleed into the color side.
Verify the italic text is legible against the dark background.
Confirm the top text feels integrated with the graphic stripes.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast color portrait with its monochromatic blue twin using a jagged diagonal paper-tear mask, then anchor the composition with high-contrast serif typography in the corners.
